Wren Street Café: Coffee, breakfast, light lunches and homemade cakes, at 14 Wren Street (example), Nottingham NG1.
Sunday: 10am till 3pm. Monday to Friday: 8am till 4pm. Saturday: 9am till 5pm.
Tables for 5 or more can be booked, and afternoon tea; smaller tables are walk-in.
Afternoon tea, £24.50 a person, £12.00 for under-12s, booked a day ahead, sittings at 12 noon, 2pm and 3:30pm. Gluten-free and vegan with 2 days' notice.
Breakfast until 11:30am; food until 30 minutes before closing, drinks and cakes until close.
Step-free from the street, with an accessible toilet. 3 high chairs.
8 tables take bookings for 5 or more; 27 items on the menu.
